items.title: If Draymond Green's contract is exactly the same as the option he declined, he'll make $27,678,571 for 26-27.
items.author: KeithSmithNBA
items.body_excerpt:
If Draymond Green's contract is exactly the same as the option he declined, he'll make $27,678,571 for 26-27.

That'll put GSW just over the first apron and about $12.4M under the second apron. That's with three roster spots that must be filled, one of which will reportedly go to De'Anthony Melton.
